metadata.subtitle: Exclusive Inaugural Issue
metadata.issue_type: Exclusive inaugural issue for Kickstarter backers only
compatibility: Other games based on Basic/Expert rules

introduction.welcome: Carcass Crawler is a zine devoted to Old-School Essentials, containing new character classes and races, new spells and magic items, new monsters, optional and expanded rules, news, previews, short adventures, and more.
in_this_issue: Fantasy Classes: Eight new character classes: arcane bard, beast master, changeling, chaos knight, mage, mutoid, mycelian, and warden.
Fantasy Races: Three new character races for Advanced Fantasy games: changeling, mutoid, and mycelian.
Expanded Equipment: More gear for expeditions into dungeons and the wilderness.
introduction.too_many_classes_advice: The new classes are optional. Referees may select a limited campaign-specific set of classes, e.g. 7-10 classes, to reinforce campaign flavour and keep player choice manageable.

fantasy_classes_overview.arcane_bard: Alternative bard inspired by 1989 Advanced 2nd edition rules; an arcane jack-of-all-trades with fighter, magic-user, and thief-like abilities.
fantasy_classes_overview.beast_master: Warrior with a special connection to animals, inspired by the 1982 film The Beastmaster.
fantasy_classes_overview.changeling: Demihuman shape-stealer based partly on folklore and the doppelgänger monster.
fantasy_classes_overview.chaos_knight: Chaotic counterpart and nemesis of the lawful paladin, bound to a chaotic patron.
fantasy_classes_overview.mage: Wizardly class based on percentile thief-skill mechanics instead of spell memorization; suited to low-magic campaigns.
fantasy_classes_overview.mutoid: Demihuman with mismatched body parts of many creatures; each individual has a unique appearance.
fantasy_classes_overview.mycelian: Fungal humanoid demihuman dwelling in the depths of the Underworld.
fantasy_classes_overview.warden: Non-magical ranger-like class adapted to wilderness life.

arcane_bard.name: Arcane Bard
arcane_bard.description: Bards are musicians and poets drawn to wandering and adventure; jacks-of-all-trades.
arcane_bard.xp_bonus: At least 13 CHA and DEX gives +5% XP; one prime requisite 16+ and the other 13+ gives +10% XP.

abilities.anti_charm: While the bard plays music and sings, allies within 30’ are immune to song-based magical effects and beguiling powers of sylvan creatures or fairies. Allies already affected gain another saving throw with +4 bonus.

arcane_magic.spellcasting: From 2nd level, bards cast arcane spells from a spell book. Progression shows spells in the bard's spell book and spells memorized by level. Spells are selected by the referee, possibly by the player. Uses magic-user spell selection.
arcane_magic.magic_items: Can use magic scrolls of spells on their spell list and items usable only by arcane spellcasters.

bard_skills.CS: Climb sheer surfaces; one roll per 100’. On failure falls at halfway point. Cannot use in chainmail.
bard_skills.PP: Pick pockets; victim above 5th level penalizes by 5% per level above 5; at least 1% failure chance; roll over twice needed success means noticed.
bard_skills.RL: Read non-magical texts in unknown languages, dead languages, and basic codes; failure prevents retry until next level.

abilities.combat: Can use leather armour or chainmail but not plate mail or shields; can use all weapons.
abilities.lore: From 2nd level, 2-in-6 chance of knowing lore pertaining to monsters, magic items, or heroes of folktale or legend; may identify nature and powers of magic items.
abilities.after_reaching_11th_level: Can establish a manor; 2d6 apprentice bards of 1st level arrive.
abilities.rolling_skill_checks: All skills except hear noise roll d%; hear noise is referee-rolled on 1d6.

beast_master.name: Beast Master
beast_master.xp_bonus: At least 13 in one prime requisite gives +5% XP. STR and WIS both 16+ gives +10% XP.
beast_master.description: Adventurers with a special connection to animals, often accompanied by loyal beasts.

abilities.animal_companions: May attempt to bond with encountered animals. Peaceful approach; referee reaction roll 8+ makes the animal a companion.

companion_requirements.types: Wild and domestic animals; giant or magical animals at referee discretion.
companion_requirements.maximum: Up to one companion per experience level; total companion HD may not exceed character level.
companion_requirements.death_or_dismissal: May attempt to forge a connection with a new animal.

abilities.companion_behavior: Follows everywhere, obeys basic commands, fights to defend the beast master, never checks morale.
abilities.clairvoyance: After reaching 5th level, can see through the eyes of animal companions with deep concentration.
abilities.combat: Can use all weapons, leather armour, chainmail, and shields.
abilities.identify_tracks: Can identify tracks and spoor of animals in the wild.
abilities.reaction_modifier: +1 bonus to reaction rolls with animals, in addition to CHA modifier.

speak_with_animals.base: Animals understand the basic meaning behind the beast master's words.
speak_with_animals.level_4: Can communicate empathically with animals without words.
speak_with_animals.limit: Communication is commensurate to animal intelligence.

abilities.after_reaching_9th_level: May construct wilderness stronghold. Animals within 5 miles become friends, may warn of intruders and carry messages/news; beast master must protect them.

changeling.name: Changeling
changeling.xp_bonus: At least 13 in one prime requisite gives +5% XP. CHA and DEX both 16+ gives +10% XP.
changeling.description: Magical demihumans with powers of deception and shape-stealing; natural form appears human.

abilities.back_stab: +4 to hit and double damage when attacking unaware opponent from behind.

skills.BE: Beguile; person of HD no greater than changeling level saves vs spells or believes words for 1 round per level; once per person per day.
skills.HS: Hide in shadows; must be motionless.

abilities.combat: Can use all weapons, leather armour, and shields.
abilities.shape_stealing: Can mimic another person with 1 round physical contact. Can steal form of killed victim within last turn or sleeping/unconscious victim; from 5th level, conscious victim via successful melee attack and failed save vs spells.

successful_shape_stealing.duration: Up to one turn per level.
successful_shape_stealing.stats: Retains own intelligence, hit points, saves, and attacks.
successful_shape_stealing.capabilities: Acquires physical capabilities, not non-physical special abilities.
successful_shape_stealing.gear: Visible clothing/gear copied; copies are nonmagical and vanish if dropped.

abilities.after_reaching_9th_level: Can establish secret base and attract 2d6 1st-level apprentices (changelings, thieves, or similar). Lost apprentices are not replaced.

chaos_knight.name: Chaos Knight
chaos_knight.alignment: Must be chaotic. If alignment changes, loses class abilities and becomes fighter of same level; referee may allow mighty sacrifice to regain status.
chaos_knight.xp_bonus: At least 13 in one prime requisite gives +5% XP. STR and WIS both 16+ gives +10% XP.
chaos_knight.description: Warriors bound to an infernal patron: chaotic deity, demon, or devil.

abilities.combat: Can use all weapons and armour.
abilities.command_undead: From 3rd level, roll 2d6 to command undead; if successful roll 2d6 HD affected; commanded undead obey for 1 round per level. Lowest HD affected first in mixed groups.
abilities.divine_magic: From 9th level may pray to receive spells from cleric list, typically reversed versions. Must carry holy symbol and remain faithful to patron.
abilities.infernal_steed: From 4th level may summon horse AC 5 [14], 5+5 HD, MV 180’ (60’). If it dies, another cannot be summoned for 10 years.
abilities.life_drain: Once per day, melee attack drains 2 hp per chaos knight level in addition to normal damage; chaos knight heals equal to hp drained.
abilities.vow_of_bondage: May keep only one suit magical armour, one magical shield, one magical melee weapon; must spend 10% income on sacrifices.
abilities.after_reaching_9th_level: With patron permission can build stronghold, control lands, and gain title such as Baron/Baroness.

legend.number: 2d6 roll must be higher or equal

mage.name: Mage
mage.xp_bonus: At least 13 INT and WIS gives +5% XP. INT 16+ and WIS 13+ gives +10% XP.
mage.description: Adventurers who study deep magic, using percentile skills rather than standard memorized spells.

abilities.arcane_magic: May perform magical research at any level, scribe scrolls, research magical effects, and from 9th create other magic items. Can cast from arcane scrolls and use arcane spellcaster items.
abilities.combat: Can use staves and one-handed blades, but no armour.
abilities.healing: Once per day spend 1 turn to heal ally: cure 1 hp per level or allow another save against a negative effect.
abilities.mage_staff: Normal staff can harm creatures immune to mundane attacks. Once per day staff radiates light in 30’ radius for 1 turn per level.

skills.DM: Detect magic; 1 turn concentration on object; may retry failed checks with more time.
skills.OC: Open/close unlocked door, portal, lid, etc.; holds open/closed for 1 round per level; once per portal.
skills.RF: Rally/fear; rally counters magical fear, fear forces morale check; once per turn.
skills.RM: Read magic; failed attempt cannot retry until next level.
skills.SU: Suggestion; up to one HD of persons per level save vs spells or follow suggestion 1 round per level; self-endangering suggestion auto-saves; once per turn.

abilities.scribing_scrolls: Any level can create arcane scrolls per magical research rules.
abilities.after_reaching_11th_level: May build stronghold/tower; 1d6 apprentices of levels 1-3 arrive.
abilities.rolling_skill_checks: All skills rolled on d%; detect magic should be referee-rolled.

mutoid.name: Mutoid
mutoid.weapons: One-handed melee weapons and all missile weapons
mutoid.description: Demihumans with mismatched body parts of many creatures; often shunned and living in ruins or hidden lairs.

abilities.back_stab: +4 to hit and double damage vs unaware opponent from behind.
abilities.combat: Can use shields, leather armour, one-handed melee weapons, and all missile weapons.
abilities.mutations: Two random mutations. Duplicate mutations may be rerolled. Two attack mutations may both be used each round.

skills.MI: Mimicry; mimic sounds of monsters/animals. Specific individual voice has -20% penalty.
skills.PP: Pick pockets; victim above 5th level imposes -5% per level over 5; roll over twice required notices theft.

abilities.after_reaching_8th_level: Can establish secret lair and attract 2d6 1st-level mutoid apprentices; lost apprentices are not replaced.

mutations.effect: Unarmed attack for 1d3 damage. Pincer locks on, causing 1d3 damage per round; save vs paralysis to escape.
Jump up to 30’ forward and gain +1 to attack. With impaling weapon, counts as a charge and inflicts double damage on a hit.
Grab an object up to 15’ away and pull it to mouth. Can be melee attack: bite inflicts 1d3 damage.

mycelian.name: Mycelian
mycelian.description: Humanoid mushrooms with tall stems, wide flat caps, beady eyes amid gills, no mouths, telepathic communication, and subterranean origins.

abilities.combat: Naturally tough skin, no armour, may use shields and any weapons.

fungal_spores.uses: Once per day per level at one target within 20’.
fungal_spores.pacifying: Target saves vs poison or becomes passive for 1 round per level, unable to act or move.
fungal_spores.hallucinogenic: From 4th level, target saves vs poison or suffers terrifying visions for 1 turn per level; d6: 1-2 flee, 3-4 cower and babble, 5-6 attempt to kill nearest creature.

abilities.growth: Starts 4’ tall at 1st level; height increases by 1’ per level to max 9’ at 6th.
abilities.light_sensitivity: In bright light suffer -2 attack and -1 AC.
abilities.rest_and_sustenance: Requires 8 hours/day in contact with moist earth. Missing period causes loss of 1 hp/day until completed.
abilities.telepathic_communication: Communicates telepathically with sentient creatures within 120’, in any known language.
abilities.after_reaching_6th_level: May found subterranean stronghold and rule mycelians as king.
abilities.fungal_reanimation: Mycelian king can implant spores into humanoid corpse to create fungal zombie in one week, with careful tending.

warden.name: Warden
warden.alignment: Lawful or neutral only; if becomes chaotic loses special abilities and becomes fighter of same level; special quest may restore status.
warden.description: Members of a secret society protecting native lands from invasion and Chaos; skilled wilderness warriors.

abilities.awareness: Only surprised on a roll of 1.
abilities.combat: All weapons, leather, chainmail, shields; cannot use plate mail.
abilities.foraging_and_hunting: Party with warden forages 2-in-6 and finds prey when hunting 5-in-6.
abilities.limited_possessions: May only keep wealth/possessions on person or mount; excess donated to worthy causes, not other PCs.
abilities.pursuit: When pursuing in wilderness, opposing group’s evasion chance reduced by 10%.
abilities.surprise_attack: In wilderness, 3-in-6 chance of going unnoticed when sneaking up; target may be surprised.
tracking_modifiers: Group size +2% per creature beyond first
abilities.after_reaching_10th_level: 2d12 followers join; may include adventurers, animals, mounts, sylvan creatures, or special monsters; not replaced if killed.

changeling.description: Magical demihumans with deception and shape-stealing; natural form looks human.

shape_stealing.stats: Retains own intelligence, hp, saves, and attack probabilities
shape_stealing.gear: Visible worn/carried items copied, nonmagical, vanish if dropped

mutoid.description: Demihumans with mismatched body parts; often shunned and live in ruins or hidden lairs.

mutations.effect: Unarmed attack for 1d3 damage. Pincer locks on, causing 1d3 damage per round; save vs paralysis to escape.
Jump up to 30’ forward and gain +1 to attack. With impaling weapon, counts as a charge and inflicts double damage on a hit.
Grab an object up to 15’ away and pull it to mouth. Can be melee attack: bite inflicts 1d3 damage.

mycelian.description: Humanoid mushrooms with telepathic communication and subterranean origin.

abilities.fungal_spores: From 3rd level, once per day, target within 20’ saves vs poison or becomes passive for 1 round per level.
abilities.rest_and_sustenance: 8 hours/day contact with moist earth or lose 1 hp/day.
abilities.telepathic_communication: Sentient creatures within 120’, any known language.

procedure: Apply ability modifiers, ignoring bonuses above 18 and penalties below 3.
Choose a class allowed by the race and any class ability requirements.
separate_race_class_procedure.native_languages: When selecting race and class separately, native languages are determined by race; class languages are ignored.
separate_race_class_procedure.asterisk_note: Asterisked classes are detailed in Old-School Essentials Advanced Fantasy; ignore them in Classic Fantasy.
